production_policy.dispatch: CUDA BF16/F16 one input token, contiguous aligned weight, matching Candle device and existing GEMV capability
production_policy.unchanged: F32, multiple tokens, incompatible layouts, bias post-matmul rounding, dynamic LoRA deltas, router top-k
production_policy.stream_fix: GEMV BF16/F16/F32 input, weight and bias guards use the launch stream

repository_test_status: All three ignored CUDA repository tests passed in the coordinated 63-test validation batch.
notes: Top-k count10; actual existing CUDA top-k kernels.
Baseline BF16 multi-token GEMM sometimes deviates from f64-reference rounded to BF16 and changes top-k; custom GEMV checked independently.
Weight pools have explicit matrix/working-set byte counts in raw timing log; small geometry pools fit L2.
Only the large rotating matrix pool approximates cache-cold model reads; small working sets fit L2.
The standalone change is about 0.053ms across 48 actual-shape BF16 routers; full-model impact must be measured.
Mixtral already uses QuantMethod and retains its existing forward dispatch.
